value.family.title: Games for every age
value.family.text: Our free games are family friendly: kids can play them and parents can trust them. We also make games for older players, with action, shooting and combat, like metroidvanias and platformers, always with the store's age rating and never with sexual content.
value.noads.title: No ads, no selling data
value.noads.text: We don't show ads, we don't sell data and the studio doesn't keep your personal data. In our games we only use Google Analytics, anonymously, to find errors and improve the game. Your time and your privacy are not our product.
value.fair.title: Fair play
value.fair.text: Nothing that gives an advantage is for sale. Our free games, like Swan Race, are truly free, with no purchases. Our paid games are sold in the stores, like Steam, at a fair price.
value.offline.title: Offline first
value.offline.text: Our games work without internet. Online features are optional.
value.open.title: Open source
value.open.text: The code of our free games, like Swan Race, is free software (GPLv3) and open to contributions on GitHub; the art is shared under Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0. Read it, learn from it, improve it. Our paid games are closed source.
value.light.title: Light
value.light.text: Small downloads that run well on ordinary phones.
about.seo.title: About us
about.title: Who we are
about.p1: Schlupfwerk is an independent game studio from Brazil. No investors, no publisher, no pressure to squeeze players: just games we would love to play.
about.p2: We make indie games for Android, iOS and PC: from free, family-friendly games to paid games for older players, with action and challenge, like metroidvanias and platformers.
about.name.title: Where the name comes from
about.name.text: The name is German. Schlupf means both the moment a chick hatches and the slip of a wheel drifting through a curve. That is what we do: we hatch ideas and make them go fast. That is why our logo is a pixel egg with a crack.
about.say.title: How to say it
about.values.title: What we believe in
about.licenses.title: Open source and Creative Commons
about.licenses.intro: Schlupfwerk believes in open development and transparency. Each part of our free games has its own license (our paid games are closed source):
about.licenses.code.title: Source code:
about.licenses.code.text: free and open source under the GNU GPL v3.
about.licenses.assets.title: Art and sound:
about.licenses.brand.title: Names and logos:
about.licenses.brand.text: Schlupfwerk and Swan Race, and their logos, identify the official games and are not covered by these licenses.
about.licenses.outro: We want developers to be able to study, learn from, improve and contribute to our code while respecting the license of the art and the identity of the project.
about.join.title: Want to help?
about.join.text: We are a tiny studio and contributions to our games are very welcome: code, art, 3D models, music, sound, translations, bug reports or just ideas. Read the project's CONTRIBUTING.md, open an issue and send a pull request. Every contributor is credited in the game. 💛

game.swan.summary: A 3D racing game for the whole family, starring a swan that can neither fly nor swim and runs all clumsy, almost like a duck, against other swans on a desert island: ramps, bridges over a lake, logs to jump and speed pads on the sand.
game.swan.free.title: Completely free
game.swan.free.text: No ads, no purchases and nothing to unlock by paying. Everyone races with the same chances.
game.swan.ai.title: AI rivals
game.swan.ai.text: Up to 11 AI-controlled swans race you every time. Each one gets its own skill, drawn from the difficulty (easy, medium or hard): it picks its line, aims for speed pads and ramps, jumps logs and the gaps in the bridges, uses the turbo on climbs and now and then makes a mistake, like people do. The AI follows the same rules and physics as you, no cheating. On easy, a swan that races far ahead eases off to wait.
game.swan.custom.title: Make your own swan
game.swan.custom.text: Up to 10 characters, each with a nickname, 25 feather colors (plain or gradient), hats, wigs, glasses, lashes, lipstick, outfits, necklaces, a backpack, a superhero cape, a dog or a cat in a bag, socks and shoes. Everything is unlocked from the start, and all of it works with a controller.
game.swan.features.title: What's already in the game
game.swan.f1: One track, the Desert Island: hills, ramps, a lake with bridges, logs and speed pads
game.swan.f2: Races with 1 to 12 swans and 1 to 10 laps
game.swan.f3: An easy mode made for kids: the swan runs by itself, just steer and jump
game.swan.f4: Works offline, no account and no internet needed
game.swan.f6: Open source (GPLv3); art under Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0

privacy.seo.title: Privacy policy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: In short: we don't show ads, we don't sell data and the studio doesn't keep your personal data. In our games we only use Google Analytics, anonymously. Here are the details, in plain language.
privacy.site.title: This website
privacy.site.text: This website does not use tracking cookies or analytics tools.
privacy.site.storage: If you pick a language, that choice is saved only in your browser (localStorage), so the site opens in the right language next time. It is never sent to us.
privacy.games.title: Our games
privacy.games.text: Our games work without internet and without an account. Online features are optional and use Google and Apple services, described below. If a new feature ever needs other data, this page will explain which data before that feature exists.
privacy.analytics.title: Google Analytics in our games
privacy.analytics.text: When there is an internet connection, our games may send anonymous usage and error information to Google Analytics: for example, that the game started, that a race ended or that something went wrong, along with the device model, the operating system and the game version. We don't send your name, email, contacts, precise location or the device's advertising ID, and this data is not used for ads. We use it only to find errors and improve our games. Without internet, nothing is sent. Google handles this data under its own privacy policy.
privacy.scores.title: Leaderboards, achievements and progress
privacy.scores.text: Leaderboards (including friends-only leaderboards), achievements and cloud-saved progress are optional and use Game Center and iCloud (iOS) or Google Play Games (Android). Those services store your nickname, your friends list, your score and your progress under Apple's and Google's privacy policies.
privacy.purchases.title: Purchases
privacy.purchases.text: Swan Race is completely free and has no in-game purchases. Our paid games are sold through the stores (Steam, App Store or Google Play), which process the payment; we never receive your card details.
privacy.donations.title: Donations
privacy.donations.text: Donations are processed by Ko-fi (with Stripe) or by Pix, through your bank. Those services handle payment data under their own policies.
privacy.children.title: Children
privacy.children.text: Our free games are made for the whole family, so we take special care with children: they have no ads, they don't ask for personal data and Google Analytics only receives anonymous data. Games for older players show their age rating in the store.
privacy.lgpd.title: Your rights (LGPD)
privacy.lgpd.text: We follow Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD). If you have any question about privacy or want to exercise your rights, get in touch.
